newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila water project bids being evaluated - official.
newsitem.headline: Manila water project bids being evaluated - official.

text.p: Technical evaluation of bids to privatise the Manila waterworks is continuing and none of those vying for the contracts have been disqualified, a senior Philippine government official said on Monday.
The Asian Wall Street Journal had said the bidding for the $7 billion project had run into trouble and could be delayed by several months.

The newspaper said one of the consortia bidding for the project had submitted a technically-flawed offer and that officials of the Metropolitan Water and Sewerage System (MWSS) were debating whether to disqualify the bidder or re-start the process from scratch.

"At this moment no conclusions have been made," said Mark Dumol, chief of staff at the Department of Public Works and Highways. "It's improper for anyone to say that a company is going to be disqualified."
The newspaper identified the flawed bid as coming from a consortium comprising Bechtel Corp of the United States, United Utilities Plc and Ayala Corp AY.PS.
Dumol said the committee evaluating the bidding was scheduled to hold "clarification meetings" with all four bidders next week as part of the technical review process.
"These meetings are being held as a matter of due course," he said, adding that the decision on the technical review would be made public on January 22.
The financial offers of bidders whose applications are cleared by the technical committee will then be opened the following day.

Other groups to bid for the two 25-year contracts to supply water to Metro Manila include Lyonnaise des Eaux SA in collaboration with Benpres Holdings Corp ; Anglian Water Plc along with Australia Water Technologies Pty Ltd and Metro Pacific Corp ; and Compagnie Generale de Eaux with Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc.
The two winners of the contracts for East and West Manila are expected to invest $7 billion over the next 25 years to improve water and sewerage services.
